works.title: VALIS
works.theological_headline: PKD reads his own novel *VALIS* alternately as revelation, theodicy, case history of his psychosis, and the theory the Exegesis is still proving.

works.title: Ubik
works.theological_headline: PKD reads Ubik back as accidental scripture: Ubik the Atman/Holy Spirit, Runciter the Logos, half-life our world.

works.title: The Three Stigmata of Palmer Eldritch
works.theological_headline: PKD reads Palmer Eldritch as the malign demiurge and predatory anti-God — the dark twin of the benign Ubik.

works.title: A Scanner Darkly
works.theological_headline: PKD reads *A Scanner Darkly* as the story of the Fall — the split self of Fred/Arctor as seeing through a glass darkly, damage as revelation.

works.title: Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said
works.theological_headline: PKD reads *Flow My Tears* as "Acts of the Apostles" time and *The Bacchae* retold: Felix Buckman's grief the doorway to the real.

works.title: Time Out of Joint
works.theological_headline: PKD reads Time Out of Joint back as the original intuition of 2-3-74: the world a fake, the real locus another time.

works.title: A Maze of Death
works.theological_headline: PKD counts A Maze of Death as one of the few places he wrote a genuine salvific entity — the manufactured gods made real.

works.title: Radio Free Albemuth
works.theological_headline: The Albemuth material is PKD drafting his own theophany as plot: the benign alien signal, the satellite, the sign — himself the smuggled-in savior.

works.title: Martian Time-Slip
works.theological_headline: Martian Time-Slip counts among the novels PKD calls politically subversive — inner-space explorations that break through to unfallen hermetic space.

works.title: Galactic Pot-Healer
works.theological_headline: PKD lists Galactic Pot-Healer among the novels where he unknowingly wrote a real salvific entity — Glimmung as an early Zebra.

works.title: The Divine Invasion
works.theological_headline: The Divine Invasion's Bible-into-hologram is PKD's fiction of God re-entering an occluded world through time seen as space.

works.title: Deus Irae
works.theological_headline: PKD names Deus Irae as the religious source-stream of VALIS — one theme fused into his final vision of God.

works.title: The Cosmic Puppets
works.theological_headline: The Cosmic Puppets is one entry in PKD's dozen-novel catalog of the same message: one world underlying another.

works.title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
works.theological_headline: PKD reads Mercer's three levels — real, fake, real — as the structure of the fake fake that is finally true, his model for Christianity.
